summary: Five-file skeleton: server/db.js persists updates via server-side PGlite, server/routes/updates.js exposes GET/POST /api/updates, server/app.js wires the router into an Express app, src/App.jsx owns the post form and fetches the list, src/components/UpdatesList.jsx renders it.

tasks.title: Build the standup tracker API and frontend
tasks.instructions: Create server/db.js, server/routes/updates.js, server/app.js, src/App.jsx, and src/components/UpdatesList.jsx.

fileContracts.purpose: Server-side PGlite persistence for standup updates.

exports.name: getDb
exports.description: Returns the shared, single-flight-initialized PGlite instance, creating the updates table on first call.

exports.name: addUpdate
exports.description: Inserts a new update and returns the inserted row.

fileContracts.purpose: Express router exposing GET/POST /api/updates, backed by server/db.js.

exports.name: updatesRouter
exports.description: Router mounted at /api/updates by server/app.js; GET lists updates, POST creates one.

fileContracts.purpose: Express application: mounts the updates API and JSON body parsing.

exports.name: app
exports.description: The configured Express application that server/index.js imports and listens on.

fileContracts.purpose: Presentational list of posted standup updates.

exports.name: default
exports.description: Renders each update's author and message, newest first.

fileContracts.purpose: Entry component: posts a new update via the API and lists existing ones.

exports.name: default
exports.description: App root component: fetches /api/updates on mount, posts new updates, renders UpdatesList.
